**Tier 3.** Its `application`, `domain` and
`infrastructure` may import only a strictly lower tier. `http/` composes freely
but may never reach into another module's `http/` or `infrastructure/`.

May import: `activity`, `catalog`, `commerce`, `identity`, `messaging`, `payments`, `plugins`, `seo`, `settings`, `vintedReviews`, `vouchers`.

Currently imports: `cart`, `catalog`, `commerce`, `identity`, `payments`.

Feature map entry: `customers` in [tuucho/docs/features.json](../../../../../docs/features.json). Run `npm run feature -- customers` for its full span.
